propositions: Provider-qualified model refs (anthropic:claude-opus-4-8, openai:gpt-5.4) passed to genai_prices.calc_price raise LookupError instead of resolving, causing rows to be silently marked unpriced with no warning.
Anthropic and OpenAI usage rows are affected asymmetrically — only Bedrock provider-prefixed models resolve and price correctly, biasing provider cost comparisons.

The id translation for pricing must be decided by registry membership (KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES) rather than string prefix matching or split operations, because Bedrock and versioned AWS ids have different remainder formats.
genuinely-unknown models must remain tolerated as unpriced (pricing never breaks summarize) but must be visibly distinguishable from mis-formatted ids in output.
LookupError catch at usage_log.py:429 correctly prevents pricing from breaking summarize, but the swallowed error makes the failure silent rather than reporting which models are unpriced.
